## [Prologue](https://www.thisamericanlife.org/746/this-is-just-some-songs/prologue-2)

Sean Cole guest hosts. A mix tape’s not-so-hidden message gets lost to the machine. (10 minutes)

## By

[Sean Cole](https://www.thisamericanlife.org/archive?contributor=8616)

## [Music is Easy](https://www.thisamericanlife.org/746/this-is-just-some-songs/track-two-7)

Sean Cole plays a minute of a tune he’s had stuck in his head. Happily. It’s a song about unburdening yourself through music. (2 minutes)

## By

[Sean Cole](https://www.thisamericanlife.org/archive?contributor=8616)

## Song:

[“Music is Easy” by Josephine Network](https://josephinenetwork.bandcamp.com/album/music-is-easy)

## [The End of the Road](https://www.thisamericanlife.org/746/this-is-just-some-songs/track-three-7)

Producer Chana Joffe-Walt really loves the slideshows that schools display at end-of-the-year parent assemblies. (12 minutes)

## [I Talk in Tunes](https://www.thisamericanlife.org/746/this-is-just-some-songs/track-five-7)

We had a song made just for you.

## Song:

“I Talk in Tunes” by Chandler Travis

If you enjoyed this episode, you may like these.
